title: Run clippy before the tests in the declared test path
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo clippy --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml && PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --test proof_gate && PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml --bin bee -- blind

truths: commands.test in .bee/config.json is a list: the clippy command first, then the unchanged cargo test command
scripts/release.sh runs every commands.test entry in order and stops at the first red one
ci.yml runs the clippy entry and the toolchain step installs clippy

action: Implement CONTEXT.md D1 and D2. (1) packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/blind/mod.rs near line 337: the for loop over heads.iter().skip(1).filter(level == 1) returns on its first pass; rewrite it as an if let on find so clippy::never_loop is gone and the refusal is byte-identical. (2) .bee/config.json commands.test becomes a JSON array: first "PATH=\"${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH\" cargo clippy --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml", then the current cargo test string unchanged. Keep the file's formatting style. (3) scripts/release.sh test gate (around line 283): read commands.test as a string or a list (jq: if type=="array" then .[] else . end; the python3 fallback the same), log and run each entry with bash -c in order, fail with the existing RED message naming the entry on the first non-zero exit; a string value behaves as today; empty still fails. (4) packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/tests/proof_gate.rs: read commands.test as a string or a list of strings; the entry starting with cargo test (after env prefix strip) keeps today's check against every cargo test line in both WORKFLOWS; each other entry, env-stripped, must equal a run line in .github/workflows/ci.yml (same plumbing strip as cargo_test_lines). Keep existing test names. (5) .github/workflows/ci.yml: the dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable step gains with: components: clippy; add a step named Run clippy before the verify chain that runs cargo clippy --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml. windows.yml unchanged. (6) docs/knowledge/areas/verify-pipeline/suite-topology-and-discovery.md: one sentence that beehive's commands.test is a list, clippy without -D warnings then the cargo suite, and CI runs both; cite clippy-in-test D1/D2 (never raw ids). Run bee knowledge check. No code comments; keep any existing shell comment lines in release.sh and ci.yml but add none. Do not add new tests; cit-2 owns them. Proof: the verify command; quote the counts. REWORK (leader check gap on commit 63b27be65): keep everything else; in scripts/release.sh the while-read loop feeds entries on stdin and bash -c inherits it, so an entry that reads stdin can consume later entries and skip them silently. Run each entry with stdin from /dev/null. Commit once more with the cell trailer and re-run the verify.
